title_sq: Tek Selvia, Shitet Njesi Biznesi Ideale Per Investim!!!
description_sq: Tek Selvia, Shitet Njesi Biznesi Ideale Per Investim!!! Ambjenti ndodhet ne katin 0 te nje pallati 11 katesh te mireadministruar me ashensor. Ka nje siperfaqe bruto 42m2 dhe neto 40m2. Ambjenti eshte totalisht i investuar dhe ka sistem kondicionimi. Njesia ndodhet ne nje zone te zhvilluar e cila ofron te gjithe facilitetet e mundshme. Ambienti eshte i gjithi me fasade xhami duke krijuar keshtu nje mundesi shume te mire reklamimi per biznesin tuaj. Mund te perdoret si per aktivitete te ndryshme si farmaci, klinika te ndryshme, laboratore te ndryshme, tregtim produktesh, zyra, etj. Orientimi eshte jug. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: In Selvia, an ideal business unit for investment!!!
description_en: In Selvia, an ideal business unit for investment!!! The facility is located on the 0th floor of a well-managed 11-story building with an elevator. It has a gross area of ​​42m2 and a net area of ​​40m2. The environment is fully invested and has an air conditioning system. The unit is located in a developed area which offers all possible facilities. The environment is all with glass facades, thus creating a very good advertising opportunity for your business. It can be used for different activities such as pharmacies, different clinics, different laboratories, product sales, offices, etc. Orientation is south. The property has full mortgage documentation.
